title: Reinforcement Learning MPPT HIL-Validation
description: Partial shading reduces photovoltaic array output by up to 60% when conventional maximum power point tracking (MPPT) algorithms converge on local maxima rather than the global maximum power point (GMPP). This repository implements a dual Q-learning MPPT agent trained system-agnostically across randomised panel configurations, irradiance patterns, and temperatures, targeting embedded deployment on the STM32F411 microcontroller (512 KB flash). The system is validated against Incremental Conductance (INC), Perturb and Observe (P&O), and Deep Q-Network (DQN) baselines using multi-seed statistical testing with toolbox-free paired t-tests and Wilcoxon signed-rank tests.
